units.source_text: 如果源氏将心中的哀情悉数写出，前太政大臣读后定会责备他感情脆弱。

en.t: If Genji were to write out all the sorrow in his heart, the former Grand Minister would surely read it and reproach him for being emotionally weak.

units.source_text: 源氏知道他的性情，所以回信写得不很感伤，只是向他表示感谢：

en.t: Genji knew his temperament, so he made his reply not very sentimental and merely expressed his thanks to him:

units.source_text: “屡承殷勤慰问，实不敢当”云云。

en.t: "I am truly unworthy of your repeated and gracious words of comfort," and so forth.
